## Core Services & Offerings

1. **Bridal Makeup & Makeover (Thriprayar & Thrissur)**:
   - URL: https://handwork-design-by-alka.netlify.app/custom/bridal-makeup
   - Description: HD bridal makeup, airbrush makeover, Hindu/Christian/Muslim traditional bridal looks, precision saree draping, bridal hairstyling, flower setting, and engagement/reception makeover packages.
   - Price: Starting from ₹3,500.

2. **Bridal Mehandi Work (Thriprayar & Thrissur)**:
   - URL: https://handwork-design-by-alka.netlify.app/custom/bridal-mehandi
   - Description: 100% natural, chemical-free organic henna for dark long-lasting stains. Arabic, Rajasthani, Indo-Western, bridal portraits, and group Sangeet mehandi packages.
   - Price: Starting from ₹1,500.

3. **Aari Work Blouse Designs**:
   - URL: https://handwork-design-by-alka.netlify.app/custom/aari-work-design
   - Description: Heavy bridal Aari, medium floral Aari, and simple neck/sleeve embroidery hand-stitched on traditional wooden frames with pure zari, beads, stones, and silk threads.
   - Price: Starting from ₹850.

4. **Custom Handworks Blouse Designs**:
   - URL: https://handwork-design-by-alka.netlify.app/custom/handworks-design
   - Description: Custom blouses stitched to measurements from customer photos (Pinterest / Instagram reference).
   - Price: Starting from ₹650.

5. **Maggam Design Works**:
   - URL: https://handwork-design-by-alka.netlify.app/custom/maggam-design-works
   - Description: Kerala traditional maggam stone embroidery and bead setting for wedding blouses and festival outfits.
   - Price: Starting from ₹700.

6. **Hand Thread & Bead Work**:
   - URL: https://handwork-design-by-alka.netlify.app/custom/hand-thread-work-embroidery
   - Description: Lightweight silk and cotton thread work, chikankari motifs, and delicate kundan & pearl beading.
   - Price: Starting from ₹450.

## How to Book or Order

1. WhatsApp your requirements or design image to +91 70257 46783.
2. For bridal makeup and mehandi: Share your wedding date, venue in Thrissur/Thriprayar, and look preferences.
3. For blouse embroidery: Share your measurements, fabric details, and reference pattern.
4. Receive a fixed quotation, confirm your booking, and get timely delivery or on-location bridal service.
